name_story.story: Wahyu can be understood through the Arabic form وَحْي, whose central sense is wahyu; revelation (indonesian form). Wahyu is the Indonesian form of Arabic وَحْي (Waḥy), meaning 'revelation'. It is used as a male given name.

faq.a: Wahyu is associated with the Arabic form وَحْي, whose core sense is wahyu; revelation (indonesian form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Wahyu?
faq.a: Wahyu is associated with Arabic. Wahyu is the Indonesian form of Arabic وَحْي (Waḥy), meaning 'revelation'. It is used as a male given name.
Yes — the underlying form وَحْي is Arabic.
Wahyu can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Wahyu should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The root و ح ي is Quranic (revelation), but Waḥy is not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Wahyu mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Wahyu is rendered وحی and carries the sense وحی، الہام.

faq.q: What does Wahyu mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Wahyu is rendered وحی and carries the sense وحی، وحی.
A romanized syllable approximation is wa-hyu. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Wahyu?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Wahyu, wahyu. Script forms are وحي, وحی, وَحْي, वह्यु.

faq.q: Is Wahyu a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
